behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.36.0 for the package's update from GitHub and the native transport without scrapligo: sudo karvi-sysutil package update installs the latest release's package when it is newer, its download checked against its .sha256, --check only reporting, --proxy URL and -k for a proxy; the native transport is karvi's own x/crypto/ssh connection with the ID native (was scrapligo-v1), and the --debug transport line drops implementation=; ssh.transports maps programs alone: the key ssh.transports.native removed, ssh.transports.native or ssh.transports.telnet and a custom slot's builtin:ID or bare ID refused transport_mapping_invalid (exit 2), the selector preferred gone (--transport preferred is transport_mapping_missing, exit 8, unless a slot maps it); native_transport_unavailable and transport_implementation_invalid retired; config show KEY refuses a name that is no key (config_unknown_key, config_key_removed) and a key the configuration does not set (config_key_unset), exit 2, before any key is printed; config show refuses --format beside keys or --explain, config_show_format_conflict (exit 4); the registry artifact's sensitive mark removed; registry 32 moves, every other counter is 0.36.0's (configuration schema 6, execution plan 15, daemon IPC 12, command record 4, job manifest and summary 5, plan report 4, credential package 2, scoreboard 5, audit 2); scrapligo v1.4.3, gotextfsm v1.2.0, and pty v1.1.24 removed, Go and the other modules are 0.36.0's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.36.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.36.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
